notes.title: Update Release Announcement of 'Shattered Divinities'
notes.content:
To correct the errors, a new version of the game has been released. 
Please update the game to the latest version before playing.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423129/1b827f440276c135e051c9721c9de2a6298f6e31.png[/img]

[b]Main Update Content: [/b]
[b]Optimization of Controller Experience[/b]
UI interface has added a fixed confirmation/cancel action using A/B buttons, and a page-turning function using the shoulder buttons.
The UI interface now supports operation with the D-pad.Optimized default controller mapping.

[b]Game Content Optimization[/b]
Improved feel of wall jump operation, supports front wall jump.
Reduced the material quantity requirement for the side quest [Damaged Whistle].
When talking to NPCs, the player character will be in invincible state.
Optimized display of certain icons.Reduced difficulty of some jump-and-run challenges.
Improved enemy hit detection while in the air.

[b]Bug Fixes[/b]
Fixed a bug where mouse cannot be used as a key during keyboard and mouse operation.
Fixed a bug where key hints change to controller buttons when clicking with the mouse.
Fixed some map clipping issues.
Fixed a bug where [Guardian Knight] and [Shield of Resistance] would not move.
Fixed possible clipping issues during map transitions.
Fixed a bug causing abnormal key conflicts during key remapping.
Fixed a bug where [Assault - Sword Qi] would deal dual damage at close range.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45423129/1b827f440276c135e051c9721c9de2a6298f6e31.png[/img]
